2.title: Pentecost
2.text: When the day of Pentecost was fully come, the disciples were all with one accord in one place. The promised Spirit came as a rushing mighty wind and as cloven tongues like as of fire, sitting upon each. They began to speak with other tongues — not gibberish, but real languages, that men of every nation in Jerusalem heard the wonderful works of God in their own dialect. Peter, no longer the man who denied his Lord, stands and preaches Christ crucified, risen, and exalted. Pricked in their hearts, the hearers cry, 'What shall we do?' His answer: 'Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins.' That day three thousand souls were added to the church.
